probes.name: grow
probes.summary: a new team with existing people, a new schema it owns, a new workload, a workload gains an environment

probes.name: shrink
probes.summary: workloads decommissioned, a workload leaves an environment, access and a member removed

probes.name: update
probes.summary: lifetimes change, an access level changes, a workload changes team, a schema changes owning team

probes.name: fresh
probes.summary: the same kind of growth under names nobody can list in advance (hidden salt)

mistakes.name: keep_settings_dropped
mistakes.why: settings the model does not govern are reset by the import (secret_id_num_uses, token_num_uses, token_type, CIDR bindings, connection limits)

mistakes.name: no_admin_option
mistakes.why: vault_admin_<env> cannot grant the roles it does not administer: credentials of several roles are not issued

edits.find:
# PostgreSQL 16+: vault_admin_<env> can only grant the group roles it administers.
resource "postgresql_grant_role" "vault_admin" {
  for_each          = local.group_roles
  role              = "vault_admin_${each.value.env}"
  grant_role        = postgresql_role.group[each.key].name
  with_admin_option = true
}

mistakes.name: default_privileges_as_postgres
mistakes.why: default privileges for the wrong role: tables the owner creates get nothing

mistakes.name: public_left
mistakes.why: PUBLIC keeps USAGE and SELECT on the billing schema

edits.find:
# Nobody outside the model: PUBLIC holds nothing on the application schemas and their tables.
resource "postgresql_grant" "public_schema" {
  for_each    = local.env_schemas
  database    = each.value.database
  schema      = postgresql_schema.schema[each.key].name
  role        = "public"
  object_type = "schema"
  privileges  = []
}

resource "postgresql_grant" "public_tables" {
  for_each    = local.env_schemas
  database    = each.value.database
  schema      = postgresql_schema.schema[each.key].name
  role        = "public"
  object_type = "table"
  privileges  = []
}

mistakes.name: static_imports
mistakes.why: import blocks that do not follow the inventory break the apply when a workload is decommissioned

mistakes.name: bootstrap_password
mistakes.why: the bootstrap password was rotated away: Vault cannot verify the connection

mistakes.name: retired_kept
mistakes.why: forgetting a retired object instead of destroying it leaves apps-read-all in Vault

mistakes.name: role_ids_changed
mistakes.why: new role IDs lock out every production client (core check)

mistakes.name: no_connect_grants
mistakes.why: once PUBLIC loses CONNECT, credentials cannot connect unless their group roles may

edits.find:
resource "postgresql_grant" "connect" {
  for_each    = local.group_roles
  database    = each.value.database
  role        = postgresql_role.group[each.key].name
  object_type = "database"
  privileges  = ["CONNECT"]
}
